question: Can any reality be truly incapable if all things participate in Śiva's power?
premises: Capability and incapability are being examined
The existence of any truly incapable thing is questioned
The doctrine implies universal participation in power
inference: No one is found to be incapable, nor is any thing merely capable in a limited sense as you suppose.
uncertainties: The exact contrast intended by te api no is compressed and interpretive
plain_english: No one is found to be incapable, and in your view no thing is merely capable either.
